旅游目的地坐标 / Destination coordinates

城市坐标：GeoNames geographical database (https://www.geonames.org/),
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Official data: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/cities5000.zip
Official field definitions and license: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt
Country-code metadata: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/countryInfo.txt
Downloaded and selected: 2026-10-17.

This curated collection selects 214 cities from the GeoNames cities5000 export.
Coordinates are unchanged WGS84 decimal-degree values from the matching city
records. Chinese display names, a curated selection, stable IDs, priority values,
and the website's country/continent identifiers were added. Hong Kong and Macau
records are presented under the website's China route. The selection is a starting
collection for personal travel planning, not a tourist-arrival or quality ranking.
GeoNames does not endorse this website.

城市坐标表示城市中心参考点，不是景区入口、住宿位置或精确导航目的地。
City coordinates are representative city-centre points, not attraction entrances,
accommodation locations or turn-by-turn navigation destinations.

36 landmark/viewpoint locations are reused unchanged from this website's existing
landmark-catalog.js. Those entries have kind: 'landmark'; GeoNames city attribution
does not claim provenance for the pre-existing landmark coordinates. Landscape
locations represent one viewpoint, not an entire natural region.

The source data is provided by GeoNames "as is", without warranty or any
representation of accuracy, timeliness or completeness.
